ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels across >95% of the visible fluke surface; high-intensity white pixels are sparse and localized to small spots and the interior edge of the notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Massive contiguous block of dark pigmentation (near-black) across both lobes. Minimal high-contrast spatial mapping consists of small white pixel clusters near the median notch and a singular high-intensity circular spot on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibits irregular serration; right lobe displays higher frequency of micro-peaks (1-4 pixel amplitude) compared to the more uniform left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the notch, terminating in upward-sweeping pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized detection of small, roughly circular white pixel clusters on the right lobe surface, likely representing barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple faint, low-contrast linear disruptions oriented diagonally across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white scar on the lower-mid section of the right lobe; irregular indentation/trauma mark on the distal tip of the right lobe.
